January, 2022
Bench: Ajay Rastogi, Abhay S. Oka
                                                     1
     ITEM NO.38                    Court 13 (Video Conferencing)            SECTION II-A
                                   S U P R E M E C O U R T O F     I N D I A
                                           RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS
     Petition(s) for Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.)                  No(s).    63/2022
     (Arising out of impugned final judgment and order dated 20-12-2021
     in CRLA(ABA) No. 817/2021 passed by the High Court Of Judicature At
     Bombay At Nagpur)
     MOHD. SALIM PIR MOHD. SAYANI                                         PETITIONER(S)
                                                    VERSUS
     THE STATE OF MAHARASHTRA                                             RESPONDENT(S)
     (FOR ADMISSION and I.R. and IA No.1296/2022-EXEMPTION FROM FILING
     C/C OF THE IMPUGNED JUDGMENT and IA No.1295/2022-EXEMPTION FROM
     FILING O.T. and IA No.1298/2022-APPLICATION FOR EXEMPTION FROM
     FILING ORIGINAL VAKALATNAMA/OTHER DOCUMENT )
     Date : 07-01-2022 This petition was called on for hearing today.
     CORAM :
                             HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AJAY RASTOGI
                             HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ABHAY S. OKA
     For Petitioner(s)
                                       Mr. Rohit Anil Rathi, AOR
                                       Mr. Shyam Mohta, Adv.
     For Respondent(s)
                              UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following
                                                 O R D E R
Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that the substance and issue involved in the instant
petition has been considered by a coordinate Bench in SLP(Crl.) No. 3602/2021 and interim
direction has been passed to protect the rights of the petitioners by an order dated 07.05.2021.

18:39:54 IST Reason:
Issue notice returnable in four weeks.
Dasti, in addition, is permitted to be served. In the meanwhile, the petitioner shall
not be arrested in reference to the FIR No.398/2021, dated 14.11.2021, registered at
Police Station Ner Parsopant, District Yavatmal, for offences punishable under
Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and
Sections 26(2)(i), 27(2)(e), 30(2)(a) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006, until further orders.
The petitioner shall cooperate in the pending investigation.
 (POOJA SHARMA)                                        (BEENA JOLLY)
COURT MASTER (SH)                                    COURT MASTER (NSH)
